annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it presents BitClub Network as a way to earn from Bitcoin-related packages that require registration and a $99 fee or package purchase. It links package purchases, partner recruitment, tiered teams, and reinvestment to percentage commissions and a stated $200 cycle value, while characterizing the model as easy and risk-free.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The speaker invites viewers to join and buy mining pools, but most of the presentation explains how purchases and reinvestment by partners at different team levels generate commissions, followed by binary-team bonuses and rank qualifications. That recruitment-linked income structure is the central mechanism. The separately described paid pools and recurring mining-related rewards support S04 as secondary.
